overall_assessment: Course descriptions and learning outcomes were generally intact in the packet, but seven of the 17 courses placed graded assessment components in coursework requirements. All four coursework-to-assessment leak flags were confirmed, and the reverse flag on BTM2001 was triggered by prose about access to an alternative exam after the actual requirements had been separated. The prerequisite empty flags all contained real prerequisites, with an extra placeholder on PT1501, while BTM1002’s empty assessment flag flagged a bare exam-aid value and the random controls exposed further issues with exam-aid labels, coursework wording, and reading-list placement.

Muntlig eksamen på nett	20	minutter
Endelig vurdering i emnet skjer på grunnlag av muntlig eksamen.
findings.description: In PT2005 and all three KRLE suspects, tables describing graded exams or final assignments and the grading text that follows them appear after genuine coursework gates in coursework_requirements. All four leak->assessment flags refer to these tables. KRLE1003N has an assessment row for exam aids, but the graded home assignment is entirely absent from that row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The assessment table arrives as text under the open coursework subheading. The table's Vurderingsform column header is visible in the row but is absent from the packet's list of read headings, so sectionize() never switches back to assessment at that point.
findings.suggested_fix: For Fjellhaug, detect tables whose first column is Vurderingsform and whose other columns describe duration, scope or weighting inside the assessment section. Start an assessment block at the table, keep its header and design rows, and keep subsequent grading prose in assessment until the next mapped boundary.

findings.evidence:
Sluttvurdering Skriftlig skoleeksamen med varighet på 5 timer.
Ved karakterfastsettelse benyttes en gradert karakterskala fra A til F, der E er laveste ståkarakter.
findings.description: Prose describing graded final assignments and exams stays attached to the preceding Arbeidskrav in three courses. In BTM1002, assessment retains only the exam-aid value. In BTM2010, it retains introductory text and an aid value, while both final assessment options are filed under coursework. PT1501 has no assessment row despite the final written assignment. The leak pre-pass missed these prose boundaries.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sluttvurdering has no mapped assessment boundary. In these layouts the reader also fails to emit it as a separate subheading, as seen in the inline BTM1002 wording and its absence from the heading list in all three examples.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an exact Fjellhaug subheading mapping from Sluttvurdering to assessment. In R/blocks.R, recognize it both as a standalone line and at the start of a paragraph with assessment prose, including when the label and description share a line. Leave the preceding Arbeidskrav in coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence:
Oppmøte og fravær

For å kunne få sluttvurdering i emnet må studenten ha fullført følgende krav
findings.description: A separate attendance section explicitly introduces requirements for receiving final assessment, but its text is absent from the extracted coursework requirements. The packet shows the gate statement and caps the source before the detailed conditions.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reader recognizes Oppmøte og fravær as a top-level heading, but its unmapped value closes the current section and leaves subsequent blocks without a destination.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the exact Fjellhaug heading Oppmøte og fravær to coursework_requirements so the attendance gate is retained alongside the other requirements.

findings.evidence: Som et arbeidskrav skal studentene i emnet delta ved en apologetikkonferanse.
findings.description: Teaching methods contains explicit or separately corroborated coursework gates. PT2005's conference attendance appears only in teaching methods. The repeated draft-submission wording in PT2005, BTM2006 and BTM2010 and the retreat and logged exercises in PT1501 also describe requirements already listed under Arbeidskrav.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The coursework pass for teaching_methods is oriented around headings. It leaves explicit coursework sentences and recurring restatements of the same gates under Organisering og arbeidsmåter.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Fjellhaug rule that moves full sentences beginning Som et arbeidskrav into coursework_requirements. When the existing requirements already specify the same draft submission or retreat and exercise log, remove the redundant requirement sentence from teaching_methods and keep any separate guidance or supervision text there.

findings.description: The exam-aid heading is dropped for Fjellhaug's Hjelpemiddeliste and Hjelpemiddelliste variants, leaving detached values such as Liste A, Liste B, Liste E or Ingen in assessment. The empty flag for BTM1002 detects a short genuine exam-aid value whose heading and graded exam are both missing from the assessment row. BTM2501 also retains an N/A value after the real exam description, while the BTM2508 control's N/A is removed.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The variants map to assessment but do not match the exact label-preserving patterns. Once values have been merged with the assessment text, placeholder cleanup may retain them.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exact assessment mappings for Hjelpemiddeliste ved eksamen and Hjelpemiddelliste ved eksamen and register both as retained labels. Drop a source exam-aid block with only N/A or a dash before merging, and retain the heading with meaningful values including Ingen.

findings.description: A bare Ingen from a separate prerequisite block is appended to PT1501's real BTM1001 prerequisite. The empty flag is a false alarm about row emptiness, but it surfaced a real stray placeholder. The other short flagged prerequisite rows contain course codes or Latin.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Prerequisite blocks are joined before placeholder cleanup, which does not drop the final placeholder after a code lacking sentence punctuation.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter standalone placeholder-only prerequisite blocks before concatenating the required and recommended prerequisite text. Preserve BTM1001 and other short real requirements.

findings.evidence: Det er faglærer som bestemmer innhold og tidsfrister for gjennomføring av arbeidskrav.
findings.description: The shared coursework introduction is split. Its first two gate sentences move to coursework_requirements, but the recurring sentence specifying who sets the coursework content and deadlines remains in assessment. The HEB1501 random control shows the same result as BTM2503.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The sentence-level coursework gate pass matches the approval condition but leaves the adjacent stock coursework sentence behind.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the Fjellhaug gate move to take the following stock sentence about who sets the requirements and deadlines when it immediately follows the matched coursework approval condition.

findings.evidence: Ved stryk får studentene anledning til å ta ny eksamen i perioden for ny/utsatt eksamen. Ny eksamen blir gitt som sekstimers hjemmeeksamen.
findings.description: Assessment retains a recurring resit scheduling notice beside a separate sentence that gives the replacement exam form and duration.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fjellhaug has no assessment cleanup rule for this stock resit scheduling sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Fjellhaug logistics rule for the exact sentence beginning Ved stryk får studentene anledning and ending i perioden for ny/utsatt eksamen. Keep the following sentence specifying the replacement assessment.

findings.description: The GRE1002 control appends an itemized block of assigned passages and page counts to course_content. Its existing reading_list gives the edition and other materials but omits those passage assignments.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reader emits Tekster as an unmapped subheading and sectionize() leaves its block with the parent course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Route a Fjellhaug Tekster subheading under Emnets innhold to reading_list when it introduces itemized citations with page counts. Preserve the descriptive paragraphs before that subheading in course_content.
